_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_copy_embalmed.py. t_eace_vizier is Vizier of Many Faces: a 0/1 blue Shapeshifter Cleric that may enter as a copy of any creature, except if it was embalmed the copy has no mana cost, is white and is a Zombie in addition to its other types; Embalm {3}{U}{U}. t_eace_frostkite is Deceptive Frostkite's clause: a copy of a creature you control with power 4 or greater, except it's a Dragon in addition to its other types and has flying. t_eace_ogre is a 4/4 vanilla Ogre with mana cost {3}{R}, the thing copied.

cards.name: Test Vizier
